accepted.definition: a brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure
accepted.simpleMeaning: a hard, see-through solid that breaks easily, whose atoms are not arranged in a regular pattern.
accepted.scope: This is the material itself, not a drinking container made from it or the amount it holds.
examples: The bowl is made of thin glass.
Glass breaks easily when it is dropped.

accepted.definition: enclose with glass
accepted.simpleMeaning: to close in or surround an open space with panes of a hard see-through material.

examples: They glassed in the porch so they could use it in winter.

accepted.definition: sculpture suspended in midair whose delicately balanced parts can be set in motion by air currents
